newsitem.title: USA: GT Bicycles sees Q1 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: GT Bicycles sees Q1 below estimates.

text.p: GT Bicycles Inc said Thursday it did not expect to meet analysts' sales and earnings estimates for the first quarter.

"Our shipments of mountain bikes to date have not met our expectations, which leads us to believe we will not meet analysts' estimates for sales and net income for the first quarter of 1997," said Mike Haynes, president and CEO of GT Bicycles.
The First Call consensus estimate for the first quarter is $0.24 per share. A year earlier the company earned $2.2 million, or $0.22 per share, on sales of $48.9 million.
The company said it expects to meet analysts' expectations for the full year, despite the first quarter shortfall.
GT Bicycles makes mid- to premium-priced mountain and juvenile BMX bicycles.
